content: Phawuloosi Maqidooniyanne Girike Buus
Asay co7u gidaappe guye Phawuloosi ammanizayta issi bolla xeygidi istta minththeththiza qaalara zoridaappe guye istta sarokkidi Maqidooniya baana kezides.
Izi aadhdhi biza deren diza ammaniza asaa lo7eththi zoren minththeththishe Girike dere bides.

Giriken heedzdzu agina takkidaappe guye markabera Sooriya geetettiza dere baanaas qoppides shin Ayhuda asati iza bolla iita miish ooththana zorettidayssa eridi Maqidooniya baggara baana qofa qachchides.
Beeriyappe Phariyoosa naa Sophaxiroosi, Tasolonqefe Arisxirokoosinne Sikondoosi, Darbeeneppe Gayiyoosinne Ximtoosi, Iisiyappe Xirofimoosinne Tiqiqoosi Phawuloosara issife bida.
Heyti wuri nuuppe kasetidi Xiro7aadan nuna naagida.
Nu qasse ukeththa ba7aaleppe guye Piliphisiyooseppe markaben istti dizaso Xiro7aada geetettizaso ichchashanththa gallas gakkidi heen laappun gallas gam7idos.
Phawuloosi Wurseththan Xiro7aada Buus
Saaminttafe koyro wogga gallas issife kath maanaas nu shiiqi dishin Phawuloosi wonto baanaas koshshiza gishshas shiiqida asaas qaala yootishin izi yo7oza leela giddoth gakkanaas adussides.
Bolla fooqen daro poo7oy dizason nu shiiqidos.

Awuxekise geetettiza issi naateththa nay maskoote bolla utti dishin Phawuloosi yo7oza adussidayssafe dendidayssan iza dhiskoy ekki bides; wolqqama dhiskon xoonettidi bolla heedzdzanththo fooqeppe duge kundiin asay denththiza wode hayqqi beettides.
Gido attiin Phawuloosi duge wodhdhidi naaza bolla hokki idimmidi, «Hayqqibeenna paxa dees, dagammofte!» gides.
Phawuloosi hessafe pude fooqe kezidi ukeththaa menththidi ammanizaytara mides; gadey wonttana gakkanaas asatara haasayettishe gam7i bides.
Asaykka hayqoppe paxida naaza izaso efidi wurikka ufayettides.
Phawuloosi Xiro7aadafe Milixine Geetettizaso Buus

Nuni Phawuloosa Markaben gelththana koyida gishshas kasetidi markaben Asosa geetettizaso bidos; nu hessa ooththiday Phawuloosi Asosa gakkanaas tohora baana koyida gishshassinne nu sinth baana mala izi azazida gishshassa.
Nu izara Asosan gaaggidi izi markaben geliin izara issife Mixiline bidos.
Wonteththa gallas heeppe dendidi sinththara diza Ki7oose geetettizaso gakkidos; qasse wonteththa gallas Saamoose geetettizaso pinnidi heeppe wonteththa gallas Miliixe gakkidos.

Phenxeqoste geetettiza Ayhudata Paaziga ba7aale baas dandayettida mala bonchchana Yerusalaamen beettana koyidi izi Iisiyan wodey aadhdhontta dishin Efesoone aadhdhi baanaas koyides. Izi hessaththo ooththana koyiday Phenxeqoste ba7aales Yerusalaamen beettanaas koyida gishshassa.
Phawuloosi Efesoone Woosa Keeththa Cimatara Wurseththa Moyzo Saroka Saroketeth
Phawuloosi Miliixeppe Efesoone Woosa Keeththa cimata ase kiittidi xeygisides.
Isttika yiin Phawuloosi istta, «Ta Iisiya gelida gallassafe haa simmiin ubba wode ta inttenara waana waana de7idaakko intte ereeta.
Ayhudati ta bolla asaa denththidi hilida gaason daro metoy ta bolla gakkikokka tani kumeththa ashketeththaranne afunththara Godaas ooththadis.
Coo dembankka, intteson intteson tani inttena tamaarsashe go7izayssa wursa inttes yootadis attiin inttena go7iza miishshaafe aykkoka ashshabeekke.
Ayhuda asata gidiinkka Girike asaa gidiinkka maaroteththan gelidi Xoossaako simmana malanne Godaa Yesusan ammanana mala lo7eththa yootadis.
«Ha7ikka ta hee gakkishin ta bolla aazi gakkanaakko erikke shin Xillo Ayanay tana azazida mala Yerusalaame bays.
Heen tana dumma dumma qashoynne metoy naagizayssa Xillo Ayanay taas yootides.
Gido attiin Godaa Yesusi taas immida woththaa woxxa wursana gakkanaassinne oosoza ta polana gakkanaas tani ta shemppos mishettike; taas imettida oosoykka Xoossaa mishiraachcho qaalaa yootokko.
«Ha7i gakkanaas ta intte giddon simerettashe Xoossa kawoteth sabbakadis; hayssafe guye inttefe oonikka mule ta ayfeso be7onttayssa ta erays.
Hessa gishshas inttefe issaadeyka dhaykko ta oyshettonttayssa hach ta inttena erisays.
Ays giikko ta Xoossa qofaa wursa inttes yootadis attiin aykkoka ta yootontta ashshiday deenna.
Xillo Ayanay inttena Xoossa dorsata heemmanaas shuumides; hessa gishshas intte hu7essinne Xoossa dorsatas naagettite; Goday ba suuththan wozzida Woosa Keeththayo naagite.
Ta bidaappe guye Xoossa dorsatas mishettontta iita asati intte gars gelanayssa ta erays.
Hessaththoka issi issi asati intte giddofe dendidi geella yo7o inttena tamaarsidi ammaniza asaappe darota gede baakko zaarana.
Hessa gishshas inttena issaa issaa heedzdzu layth qammanne gallas afunththan zoridayssa yuushshi qopitenne naagettite.
«Ha7ikka inttena Xoossas minththi essanaassinne ammanizayta giddon inttes laataso immanaas dandayza iza aadho kiyateththa qaalaas ta hadara immadis.
Ta oona biraakka worqqaka woykko may7o ammotabeekke.
Tani ta kushen ooththa ooththada taas maadettada tanara dizaytakka maaddidayssa intteka ereeta.

‹Haa ekkizaadefe gede immizaadey anjjettidaade› giza Godaa Yesusa qaalaa nu yuushshi qoppidi nurkka nu kushera nu ooththi demmidi hara daaburanchchata gede maaddanaas nuus bessizayssa ta inttena daro dumma dumma ogera bessadis» gides.
Hessafe guye Phawuloosi ubba asaara gulbatidi woossides.
Asay wuri yeekkishe Phawuloosa idimmi oykkidi yeerides.
Harappeka istti daro mishettiday izi, «Hayssafe guye intte nam7anththo tana beyekketa» gida gishshassa; heeppeka iza markabekko gakkanaas moyzida.

footnotes.text: «Saaminttafe koyro gallassan» qeera omars woggay wonttanawu guussa.
